integrity: Complete self-contained proof with an independently runnable standard-library Python mathematical checker; finite tests supplement the proof. Public source study is acknowledged, not represented as novel.
scientific_limitations: Steady-state Haldane response under arbitrary bounded irradiance laws with a fixed mean; no finite-frequency or depth-dependent optimal-control assertion. The original inflection and slow-light limit are prior results. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Sharp two-level illumination optimum for a bounded Haldane photosynthesis response
